Name: Cartographer
Description: Records each new map sector reached while completing tasks; its route journal shows how much ground it has covered.
Mechanic: Records each new map sector reached while completing tasks; its route journal shows how much ground it has covered.

Name: Auditor
Description: Can audit the number of tasks completed since the previous checkpoint and earn a bonus vote when progress is found.
Mechanic: Can audit the number of tasks completed since the previous checkpoint and earn a bonus vote when progress is found.

Name: Relay
Description: Decodes one signal for every two completed tasks.
Mechanic: Decodes one signal for every two completed tasks.

Name: Quartermaster
Description: Unlocks a one-use emergency meeting call after completing four tasks.
Mechanic: Unlocks a one-use emergency meeting call after completing four tasks.

Name: Surveyor
Description: Builds a survey by recording distinct task types and map sectors.
Mechanic: Builds a survey by recording distinct task types and map sectors.

Name: Courier
Description: Every completed task is recorded as a delivery in its personal ledger.
Mechanic: Every completed task is recorded as a delivery in its personal ledger.

Name: Archivist
Description: Maintains a rolling event ledger containing task completions and meetings.
Mechanic: Maintains a rolling event ledger containing task completions and meetings.

Name: Beaconist
Description: Charges a beacon for every two completed tasks and can claim a bonus vote when charged.
Mechanic: Charges a beacon for every two completed tasks and can claim a bonus vote when charged.

Name: Mediator
Description: Earns one bonus vote at the first meeting after completing three tasks.
Mechanic: Earns one bonus vote at the first meeting after completing three tasks.

Name: Calibrator
Description: Earns a bonus vote at a meeting after completing the same task type twice in a row.
Mechanic: Earns a bonus vote at a meeting after completing the same task type twice in a row.

Name: Signalwright
Description: Earns a bonus vote at a meeting after completing three different task types consecutively.
Mechanic: Earns a bonus vote at a meeting after completing three different task types consecutively.

Name: Timekeeper
Description: Stores task-count checkpoints and compares progress between snapshots.
Mechanic: Stores task-count checkpoints and compares progress between snapshots.

Name: Counterfeiter
Description: Can prepare one decoy task-board entry and track how many forged reports remain available.
Mechanic: Can prepare one decoy task-board entry and track how many forged reports remain available.

Name: Echoist
Description: Emits a short signal cue and records each echo so reported events can be compared.
Mechanic: Emits a short signal cue and records each echo so reported events can be compared.

Name: Blackout Artist
Description: Applies an eight-second dark visual filter to its character display, then restores its normal appearance.
Mechanic: Applies an eight-second dark visual filter to its character display, then restores its normal appearance.

Name: Broker
Description: Receives one additional vote at every meeting and records each clue-trade activation.
Mechanic: Receives one additional vote at every meeting and records each clue-trade activation.

Name: Decoyist
Description: Can reposition to a nearby player to create a decoy movement pattern.
Mechanic: Can reposition to a nearby player to create a decoy movement pattern.

Name: Ledgerist
Description: Stores a separate task-ledger checkpoint and tracks each delayed refresh window.
Mechanic: Stores a separate task-ledger checkpoint and tracks each delayed refresh window.

Name: Switchboarder
Description: Swaps positions with the nearest player using a networked position exchange.
Mechanic: Swaps positions with the nearest player using a networked position exchange.

Name: Weathermaker
Description: Changes its character's visual palette for eight seconds to signal a new ambient condition.
Mechanic: Changes its character's visual palette for eight seconds to signal a new ambient condition.

Name: Misdirector
Description: Can return to its previous meeting checkpoint to confuse movement tracking.
Mechanic: Can return to its previous meeting checkpoint to confuse movement tracking.

Name: Scrambler
Description: Scrambles its recorded status sequence and tracks each scramble activation.
Mechanic: Scrambles its recorded status sequence and tracks each scramble activation.

Name: Parasitic Signal
Description: Attaches a visible signal outline to a nearby player and records the tagged target.
Mechanic: Attaches a visible signal outline to a nearby player and records the tagged target.

Name: Jigsaw
Description: Collects a pattern fragment for each distinct task type completed.
Mechanic: Collects a pattern fragment for each distinct task type completed.

Name: Pilgrim
Description: Builds a route by completing different task types without repeating the previous one.
Mechanic: Builds a route by completing different task types without repeating the previous one.

Name: Curator
Description: Catalogues each unique combination of task type and map sector.
Mechanic: Catalogues each unique combination of task type and map sector.

Name: Wayfinder
Description: Builds a route by moving between map sectors; each sector transition is a route stop.
Mechanic: Builds a route by moving between map sectors; each sector transition is a route stop.

Name: Collector
Description: Collects one artifact for each new map sector visited while completing tasks.
Mechanic: Collects one artifact for each new map sector visited while completing tasks.

Name: Metronome
Description: Completes groups of three different task types in a row to maintain a rhythm sequence.
Mechanic: Completes groups of three different task types in a row to maintain a rhythm sequence.

Name: Cartouche
Description: Collects distinct pairs of task types as matching symbols.
Mechanic: Collects distinct pairs of task types as matching symbols.

Name: Lighthouse
Description: Restores one beacon segment for every pair of completed tasks.
Mechanic: Restores one beacon segment for every pair of completed tasks.

Name: Weathervane
Description: Builds prediction progress by maintaining a sequence of alternating task types.
Mechanic: Builds prediction progress by maintaining a sequence of alternating task types.

Name: Puzzlewright
Description: Solves its logic sequence by avoiding consecutive repeats of the same task type.
Mechanic: Solves its logic sequence by avoiding consecutive repeats of the same task type.

Name: Time Capsule
Description: Compares task-count snapshots to measure progress between checkpoints.
Mechanic: Compares task-count snapshots to measure progress between checkpoints.

Name: Nomad
Description: Builds an itinerary score by returning to previously visited sectors after leaving them.
Mechanic: Builds an itinerary score by returning to previously visited sectors after leaving them.
